svg.title: Measuring AI-DLC
svg.desc: Activity metrics such as lines of code generated, hours saved and prompts submitted are easy to count and easy to misread. AI-DLC should be measured by engineering outcomes: time from intent to validated implementation, traceability, compliance, defects and rework, test effectiveness, predictability, and production reliability.

text.font-family: 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: WHY THIS IS MORE THAN AN AI CODING EXERCISE

text.font-family: Manrope, 'DM Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: More code is not more delivery capability.
